rule: Curated list of YGOPRODeck set-code prefixes (cardsets.php `set_code`) treated as classic Duel Monsters sets, for set-level badges and filters only. Card-level membership and overall progress come from classic-cards.json, the exact target pool. Included: the English TCG products released 2002-03-08 to 2004-09-29 that the owner's checklist ('YuGiOh_Duel_Monsters_Collection.xlsx', 2026-10-27) counts, whose YGOPRODeck set holds only that era: core boosters LOB through AST (Spell Ruler is MRL in print and SRL on YGOPRODeck), the Yugi/Kaiba/Joey/Pegasus and Evolution Starter Decks, Tournament Packs 1-4, the 2002 Booster Pack Collectors Tin, McDonald's promos, Exclusive Pack, Movie Pack and Duelist League 1. Excluded: products released after 2004-09-29 (Soul of the Duelist onward, Dark Beginning/Revelation, Collectible Tins 2004-2005, Tournament Packs 5-7, later reprint decks) and multi-year promo sets. A set is classic when its prefix is listed here; change it only by editing this file and bumping `version`.
